title: Angels & Demons
classifier_reason: The film follows a symbologist investigating a conspiracy involving kidnapped cardinals and a secret society.
judge_reason: Although it involves solving a puzzle and investigating kidnappings, the film's fast-paced, high-stakes pursuit, suspense, and action-oriented plot align more with a Thriller than a classic Mystery.

title: Clueless
classifier_reason: A lighthearted teen comedy focusing on social dynamics, makeovers, and romantic misadventures in high school.
judge_reason: Clueless is principally a light-hearted teen/romantic comedy centered on social satire, makeover hijinks, and humorous character interactions.

title: 27 Dresses
classifier_reason: The film focuses on a woman's romantic entanglements and her desire for love and marriage.
judge_reason: The film's central conflict and resolution revolve around romantic relationships and the protagonist's love life, making it a clear example of the Romance genre.

title: Attack on Titan: THE LAST ATTACK
classifier_reason: This film features colossal-sized battles and a desperate race to stop a world-ending plan, fitting the Action genre.
judge_reason: The story focuses on large-scale combat, high-intensity set pieces, and physical conflict central to Action films.

title: Those Who Wish Me Dead
classifier_reason: The film features assassins, a chase, and a survival expert fighting for their life against numerous threats.
judge_reason: The plot centers on a tense manhunt, survival, and suspenseful cat-and-mouse dynamics—hallmarks of a thriller more than a straight action film.

title: Kong Tao
classifier_reason: The film involves black magic and unexplained deaths, suggesting supernatural and frightening elements central to the horror genre.
judge_reason: The central presence of black magic causing unexplained deaths and an atmosphere of supernatural menace fits the conventions of Horror.

title: The Bourne Supremacy
classifier_reason: This film features intense fight sequences, car chases, and a protagonist who is a skilled operative forced to use his combat abilities.
judge_reason: The film is driven by high-octane physical combat, chase sequences, and espionage set-pieces that define the Action genre.

title: Monster House
classifier_reason: This movie features a house that is a sentient monster, directly fitting the horror genre's themes of fear and supernatural threats.
judge_reason: Monster House is primarily an animated family adventure/comedy with spooky elements rather than a straight horror film, so 'Animation' better captures its core genre.

title: The Eight Hundred
classifier_reason: The film depicts a historical battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War, focusing on soldiers fighting in a desperate conflict.
judge_reason: The plot centers on a military siege and combat during the Second Sino-Japanese War, making it primarily a War film.

title: Madulas
classifier_reason: The story builds suspense around a charming character with a dark secret and escalating obsession, fitting the thriller genre.
judge_reason: The synopsis emphasizes escalating obsession, a hidden dark secret, and suspenseful danger in a high-stakes setting—hallmarks of a thriller.
